// Shape modelled on the public kingpin command tree of thanos-io/thanos
// cmd/thanos (Apache-2.0). Names and structure are trimmed; this is not a
// verbatim copy.
package main

import (
	"os"

	"github.com/alecthomas/kingpin/v2"
)

func main() {
	app := kingpin.New("thanos", "A tool")
	app.Flag("log.level", "Log filtering level.").Default("info").Enum("error", "info")
	sidecar := app.Command("sidecar", "Sidecar")
	registerSidecar(sidecar)
	query := app.Command("query", "Query")
	registerQuery(query)
	kingpin.MustParse(app.Parse(os.Args[1:]))
}
